figures.caption: Precision-recall points for human agreement: we compute precision and recall by treating one human caption as prediction and benchmark it against the others to obtain points on the precision recall curve. We plot these points for example nouns (top left), adjectives (top center), and verbs (top right), and for all words (bottom left). We also plot the fit of our model for human agreement with the empirical data (bottom left) and show how the human agreement changes with different number of captions being used (bottom right). We see that the human agreement point remains at the same recall value but dips in precision when using fewer captions.
